ranking.name: Hampton Inn New Orleans-St. Charles Ave./Garden District

text.text_excerpt: What a find! We unexpectedly decided to spend some time in New Orleans and wanted a hotel that would keep my husband's Hilton Honors account active. Hubby also is a loyal listener to Harry Shearer's "Le Show" so we knew we wanted to stay in the Garden District. The Hampton Inn was perfect for us. Right on the streetcar line, close to several great food & drink establishments and just a great hotel all in all. We decided to add a third night before we even checked in and they linked the two reservations so we didn't have to do a thing. Beautiful courtyard with a one-lane lap pool. We took our breakfast out there each morning. Typical Hampton Inn breakfast. The afternoon cheese and tea rece...

Stayed here with a group of friends under my Hilton employee discount. I throughly enjoyed my stay, as did they! The girl who checked me in was very kind and informing. Rooms are clean, housekeeping does a wonderful job. We had a problem with our A/C and the maintenance man, Gary, replaced our A/C with a brand new one even though we commented on a very small rattle. Now THAT is guest service...these guys totally went above and beyond for us. It is hotels like this that will keep us as returning guests...even the five star hotels I've stayed in throughout my life would not go above and beyond for us as much as these guys did. My partner and I are locals but had a little staycation at this St. Charles location a few weeks ago. We had a perfectly pleasant stay. The room was FREEZING when we entered so it took a while to thaw out. It was very clean except for some stray hairs we found in the bathroom. The parking lot was larger than expected and we had no issues, but it's not in a garage, so anyone from the street can access it. We paid ($15 + tax) to park which isn't bad in NOLA. The location is about as great as you can get in the city. We walked all around the neighborhood and to a restaurant down the street in perfect weather.
